## 4. Verification Method

1. Exact-byte identity, producer, seat, stage and common master directive were recalculated.
2. X Dataset/Series Identity was matched only to a Y Time object that names the same Dataset or an explicitly typed related object.
3. Dataset, edition, series, observation period, release event, revision event and snapshot were placed in separate fields.
4. Existing official URLs were re-entered only for direct conflict, position and stable-identity checks.
5. Generic P3 labels were split append-only; no input byte was rewritten.
6. No observation bulk data, economic relation, currency-role or C30 judgment was formed.

| RE-08 | ECB Data Portal | EXR spot example | EXR.D.GBP.EUR.SP00.A | Spot reference-rate subtype expresses foreign-currency units per EUR; this direction is not universal across EXR EER/HCI records. | https://data.ecb.europa.eu/data/datasets/EXR |
| RE-09 | BIS Data Portal | Effective exchange rates | BIS EER / I1.B / I1.N / I2.B / I2.N | Price-index object with broad/narrow nominal/real templates; exact time-series key still required. | https://data.bis.org/topics/EER/data |

Re-entry was restricted to source families already present in Data.X or Data.Z. No additional source family was introduced.

| `NY.GDP.MKTP.CD` | GDP | current USD | Nominal | Current | — | — | Distinct from KD and PPP |
| `NY.GDP.MKTP.KD` | GDP | constant 2015 USD | Real | Constant | 2015 | — | Distinct from current USD |
| `NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.CD` | GDP PPP | current international dollar | PPP | Current | current PPP | — | Distinct from PP.KD |
| `NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD` | GDP PPP | constant 2021 international dollar | PPP/Real | Constant | 2021 | — | Distinct from PP.CD |
| `PA.NUS.FCRF` | Official exchange rate | LCU per USD | Nominal | — | — | LCU/USD | Inverse is distinct |
| `ECB EXR spot` | Reference spot rate | foreign currency per EUR | Nominal | — | — | CCY/EUR | Not transaction price |
| `BIS EER` | NEER/REER | index 2020=100 | Nominal/Real | Index | 2020 | appreciation direction | Not bilateral FX |
| `BIS Triennial` | FX turnover | average daily USD equivalent | Nominal volume | — | — | not a price quote | Turnover ≠ price/position |
| `BOP` | External transactions | currency amount / ratio | Nominal flow | Current | — | — | Period flow |
| `IIP` | External position | currency amount | Nominal position | Current valuation | — | — | Point-in-time stock |
| `COFER` | Reserve composition | USD / share | Nominal position | Current valuation | — | — | World aggregate |
| `Pink Sheet` | Commodity benchmark | USD per physical unit | Nominal price | Current | — | series-specific | Grade/location/unit required |

## 22. Cross-confirmed Registry

```yaml
cross_confirmed_registry:
  exact_input_bindings: 2
  canonical_mapping_record_count: 36
  SCHEMA_CROSS_CONFIRMED: 14
  SCHEMA_PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: 9
  DATASET_VINTAGE_RELATION: 3
  SOURCE_SCOPE_DIFFERENCE: 2
  SINGLE_SEAT_SCHEMA_BOUND: 8

  high_confidence_relations:
    - IMF.RES:WEO is the Dataset identity; April 2026 is a vintage/release relation.
    - WDI current, constant, PPP-current and PPP-constant GDP are distinct Series.
    - IMF MFS_CBS, MFS_MA and MFS_IR are distinct Dataset identities.
    - IMF ER is not IMF EER.
    - BIS EER is a price-index object; BIS Triennial is a turnover-survey object.
    - ECB EXR uses the ECB_EXR1 DSD and a five-dimension series key.
    - BOP flow is not IIP/PIP/DIP/IIIPCC position or composition.
    - BIS LBS residence/unconsolidated is not CBS nationality/consolidated.
    - CNY is an ISO currency identity; CNH is an offshore-market label.
```

## 4. Source Re-entry Log

Only official or institution-authored source families already named in the two inputs were re-entered.

| Re-entry | Source | Official route | Verified scope |
|---|---|---|---|
| `REENTRY-001` | ECB Euro area codes | `https://data.ecb.europa.eu/help/euro-area-codes` | Fixed composition and changing composition are separate reference-area objects; historical periods use the composition applicable to that period. |
| `REENTRY-002` | ECB Bulgaria introduces the euro | `https://www.ecb.europa.eu/press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260101~c830245e42.en.html` | Bulgaria adopted the euro on 2026-01-01 and became the 21st euro-area member. |
| `REENTRY-003` | ECB euro reference-rate methodology | `https://data.ecb.europa.eu/methodology/exchange-rates` | Reference rates use a daily concertation around 14:15 CET and are usually published around 16:00 CET; they are not transaction prices. |
| `REENTRY-004` | IMF COFER FAQ | `https://data.imf.org/en/Datasets/COFER/Frequently-Asked-Questions` | Annual data are available for 1995–1998 and quarterly data from 1999Q1; from 2025Q3 the unallocated portion was removed with revisions back to 2000Q1. |
| `REENTRY-005` | IMF COFER dataset page | `https://data.imf.org/Datasets/COFER` | COFER is aggregate and confidential at country level; 2025Q3 introduced complete allocation and an imputed-share disclosure. |
| `REENTRY-006` | BIS central-bank policy rates | `https://data.bis.org/topics/CBPOL` | The main policy-rate series can splice target, repo, discount or selected traded rates across consecutive periods; metadata identify breaks. |
| `REENTRY-007` | BIS international banking FAQ | `https://data.bis.org/faq?stats-faqs=2` | LBS is residence/unconsolidated including intragroup positions; CBS is consolidated parent-nationality based and excludes intragroup positions. Revisions enter the next scheduled release. |
| `REENTRY-008` | BIS LBS overview | `https://data.bis.org/topics/LBS` | Reporting-population, reporting-practice and methodology changes create breaks; adjusted changes are not raw changes in amounts outstanding. |
| `REENTRY-009` | BIS release calendar | `https://data.bis.org/release-calendar` | Initial and revision releases are separate dated events for quarterly banking statistics. |
| `REENTRY-010` | WTO global trade statistics | `https://www.wto.org/english/res_e/statis_e/statis_e.htm` | Preliminary annual data are published in April; revised services data in July and revised merchandise data in October. |
| `REENTRY-011` | Federal Reserve FOMC calendar | `https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm` | Statements occur on the policy-decision date and minutes are released three weeks later. |
| `REENTRY-012` | Federal Reserve historical materials | `https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomc_historical.htm` | Transcripts are distinct later snapshots and are generally released with about a five-year lag; SEP is a separate document state. |
| `REENTRY-013` | BIS renminbi onshore/offshore study | `https://www.bis.org/publ/work446.htm` | CNH denotes the offshore renminbi market, distinct from the onshore CNY market; it is not promoted to a separate ISO currency identity. |

## 19. Common Clock Mapping

| Source object | Local clock | UTC mapping state | Mapping boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| ECB reference rates | CET/CEST | `PARTIAL_DATE_AWARE` | Concertation and publication are separate |
| FOMC documents | U.S. Eastern | `PARTIAL_DATE_AWARE` | Statement, minutes and transcript have distinct lags |
| BIS releases | Date-level publication calendar | `DATE_LEVEL_ONLY` | Initial and revision events separate |
| IMF calendar | IMF portal clock | `TIMEZONE_NOT_CLOSED` | Displayed time cannot be normalized exactly |
| World Bank/WDI | Publication/update clock | `DATASET_SPECIFIC` | Update date does not create full vintage |
| Country reporters | Local statistical clock | `REPORTER_SPECIFIC` | Reporting schedules and revisions vary |
| Market observations | Market/session-specific | `MARKET_SPECIFIC` | Business date can differ from UTC date |

## 20. Cross-confirmed Registry

| Record | Object | Cross judgment | Confirmed boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| `YZ-WEFX-001` | C30 Selection-readiness | `TIME_ENTITY_PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED` | WEO contains forecasts/estimates and groups; WDI contains current API values and aggregates. Same retrieval date does not create same vintage. |
| `YZ-WEFX-002` | Euro Area Composition | `MEMBERSHIP_TIME_VARIANT` | Current 21-member composition is valid for current/fixed objects but not automatically for historical observations. |
| `YZ-WEFX-003` | CNY·CNH Time and Market | `TIME_MARKET_CROSS_CONFIRMED` | CNY identifies the currency; CNH identifies an offshore market context. |
| `YZ-WEFX-004` | FX Observation Clocks | `COMMON_CLOCK_MAPPING_PARTIAL` | A common UTC date can contain non-equivalent price objects and averaging windows. |
| `YZ-WEFX-005` | Policy Rate Instrument Changes | `METHODOLOGY_BREAK_CONFIRMED` | One plotted series does not imply one stable instrument identity. |
| `YZ-WEFX-006` | COFER Coverage and Methodology Break | `METHODOLOGY_BREAK_CONFIRMED` | Current revised history is not the same publication vintage as pre-2025Q3 data. |
| `YZ-WEFX-007` | AREAER Regime State | `TIME_ENTITY_PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED` | Later editions may revise historical descriptions while the underlying policy event retains its own date. |
| `YZ-WEFX-008` | PIP·DIP·IIP·IIIPCC Reporter Coverage | `REPORTING_POPULATION_VARIANT` | Coverage expansion or a new selected-currency field is not an economic flow. |
| `YZ-WEFX-009` | BIS LBS·CBS Reporting Population | `REPORTING_POPULATION_VARIANT` | A reporting-population increase is a statistical break, not automatically an underlying capital flow. |
| `YZ-WEFX-010` | WTO·UN Trade Revisions | `TIME_ENTITY_PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED` | Balanced estimates and mirror data are not reporter observations. |
| `YZ-WEFX-011` | Economic Entity Classification Changes | `MEMBERSHIP_TIME_VARIANT` | Statistical area, sovereignty and currency area are not interchangeable. |
| `YZ-WEFX-012` | Policy Event Clock | `EVENT_CLOCK_CONFIRMED` | Document order records communication chronology, not economic causality. |
| `YZ-WEFX-013` | Market and Jurisdiction Identity | `TIME_MARKET_CROSS_CONFIRMED` | Market labels, currency identities and statistical bases cannot be merged. |

## 21. Source-scope Difference Registry

| Difference | Left source scope | Right source scope | Preservation rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SD-001` | WEO edition vintage | WDI mutable current update | Same retrieval date is not same dataset vintage. |
| `SD-002` | Euro area fixed composition | Changing composition | One area label can carry different membership rules. |
| `SD-003` | CNY currency identity | CNH offshore market label | Currency and market segment are separate axes. |
| `SD-004` | ECB reference rate | Market transaction rate | Information-only reference process is not executable market price. |
| `SD-005` | BIS policy-rate long series | One stable instrument | Spliced sequence can contain instrument changes. |
| `SD-006` | COFER current revised history | Pre-2025Q3 publication snapshots | Current back-revised values are not old vintages. |
| `SD-007` | AREAER report edition | Policy effective date | Publication clock does not substitute for event clock. |
| `SD-008` | Reported investment position | Mirror or balanced estimate | Different evidence classes and coverage. |
| `SD-009` | LBS residence basis | CBS parent-nationality basis | Different consolidation and intragroup treatment. |
| `SD-010` | WTO release stage | UN Comtrade latest-version state | Different revision and archive architectures. |
| `SD-011` | Current classification | Historical membership | Classification snapshot is time-bound. |
| `SD-012` | Policy statement/decision | Minutes/account/transcript | Distinct communication snapshots. |

## 22. Temporal Conflict Registry

| Conflict | Object | Conflict | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TC-001` | Euro Area 21 historical projection | Current/fixed I10 object can be misapplied to pre-2026 periods. | `CURRENT_STATE_PROJECTION_PROHIBITED` |
| `TC-002` | COFER methodology vintage | 2025Q3 back-revised current series can overwrite pre-change publication states. | `TEMPORAL_IDENTITY_CONFLICT` |
| `TC-003` | WDI historical vintage | Release notes exist but complete old observation snapshots are not native for all series. | `UNRESOLVED` |
| `TC-004` | IMF release timezone | Some release-calendar times lack an explicit timezone. | `COMMON_CLOCK_MAPPING_PARTIAL` |
| `TC-005` | Policy-rate splice | One continuous numeric series can contain different policy instrument identities. | `CORRECTION_REQUIRED` |
| `TC-006` | Reporter population | Coverage changes may appear as economic changes unless break metadata are applied. | `REPORTING_POPULATION_VARIANT` |
| `TC-007` | Single-version trade portal | Prior public values cannot be reconstructed without archived extracts. | `UNRESOLVED` |
| `TC-008` | CNY/CNH notation | Market notation may be promoted incorrectly to separate ISO currency identity. | `CORRECTION_REQUIRED` |
| `TC-009` | Policy event timezone | ET and CET/CEST mapping depends on event date and daylight-saving state. | `COMMON_CLOCK_MAPPING_PARTIAL` |

## Final Guard

```text
Same Institution is not Same Subject.
Same Date is not Same Clock.
Date-only is not Intraday Timestamp.
Generic FX Clock is not BIS-specific Evidence.

Current Membership is not Historical Membership.
Reporting Population Change is not Economic Flow.
Methodology Revision is not Economic Change.
Current Revised History is not Historical Publication Vintage.

CNY is Currency Identity.
CNH is Offshore Market Label.
Resolved Nonidentity is not Unresolved Conflict.
Temporal Version Relation is not Contradiction.
Statistical Break Relation is not Economic Flow.

Gap Number is not Next-data Number.
Stage Gate is not Missing Source.
Second 2d is not Second 3d.
Result.Data is not Track DB.
Relation is not Merge.
```
